description: This file defines audit service functions for login activity, including fetching login activity logs with date filtering and recording login activity entries, primarily for enterprise platform.

methods.name: aMonthAgo
methods.description: Returns a Date object representing one month prior to the current date.

methods.name: setDateToStartOrEndOfDay
methods.description: Sets the time of a given date string to the start or end of the day.

methods.name: fetchLoginActivity
methods.description: Fetches paginated login activity logs filtered by date range and activity codes.

methods.name: recordLoginActivity
methods.description: Records a login activity entry if platform is enterprise.
